text:
julia: quick sync  prototyping a tighter CTA rhythm for list rows and the compact toolbar. trying to land a single token change today.

mike: what's the numeric change? PM wants a single token bump if possible.

julia: current intra-action gap is `--space-3` (12px). proposal: adopt `--space-2` (8px) for action groups only, keep container padding `--space-3`. adds a `.btn--compact` variant for short actions.

tara: keep icon-only controls 44x44. if we reduce padding for labeled buttons, set `min-width:80px` so labels don't collapse. we had truncation surprises last sprint.

julia: sample CSS for the doc:```css
.action-group{display:flex;gap:var(--space-2);align-items:center}
.btn--compact{padding:0 calc(var(--space-2) - 2px);min-width:80px;height:44px}
.btn--icon{width:44px;height:44px}
```

owen: accessibility: DO NOT reorder DOM to achieve visual priority. keep primary first in DOM; use visual transforms only. reordering broke keyboard flow before.

a11y-bot: checklist: focus ring color `--color-focus-strong`, outline-offset 3px, ensure :focus-visible behavior, NVDA/VO tests for wrap.

mike: toasts 514: currently they anchor bottom-right and overlap right-rail CTAs. options? top-right for desktop, top-center for multi-column, bottom-center for mobile.

julia: agree. propose newest-on-top, max 3, `--toast-gap: var(--space-2)`, auto-dismiss 6s info / 12s warn / persistent error. use `aria-live="polite"` unless `role='alert'`.

tara: implementation note: set `pointer-events:none` on container and `pointer-events:auto` on toasts to avoid clicks bleeding through. offset container with `--space-4` so it never collides with right-rail CTAs.

owen: screen-reader behavior: only announce the newest toast. add a debounce so toasts within 400ms collapse into the newest announcement. Esc dismisses toast and returns focus to triggering element.

mike: copy nit: use `Dismiss` for toast action and sentence case for compact button labels.

julia: i'll open the tokens PR (`--space-2` for action groups, `--toast-gap`) and update the component docs with examples: dense table row, right-rail card, mobile wrap. will include the a11y checklist and test steps.

a11y-bot: please add a SR test: trigger two toasts within 300ms, verify only newest announced on NVDA and VoiceOver.

deploy-bot: preview deployed at https://deploy-preview.redwood/design/row-cta-rhythm-2012345678  visual diffs + token changes.

julia: thanks all  i'll wait for a11y + eng signoff and then freeze for the sprint. :pray:
